zh-CN: 归档完整核对源结构，保留空目录与跨盘暂存，遇到变化时保护原件。
改进队列批次、并发、目录校对与仓库搜索，并提供更安全的导入和导出。
v2 CLI/MCP 提供持久回执与任务恢复；用户数据切换经独立重启验收。
en-US: Archives verify complete source structure, preserve empty folders and cross-drive staging, and protect originals when changes occur.
Improve queue batches, concurrency, folder review, and Warehouse search, with safer imports and exports.
The v2 CLI/MCP adds durable receipts and task recovery; data-area switches receive a separate restart check.
